<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Do not edit; change the source and regenerate. -->

```bash
vulnetix agent install
```

It detects the coding agents you have, writes each one's hook config in its own
dialect, places the skills in each host's real directory, configures the MCP
server where the host speaks MCP, and reports what it found. Re-running is safe
and says that nothing changed.

No CLI yet:

```bash
brew install Vulnetix/tap/vulnetix        # or scoop, nix, or:
curl -fsSL https://cli.vulnetix.com/install.sh | sh
```

## What each agent gets

Generated from `vulnetix agent hosts`. There used to be a page per agent here,
forty-one of them, hand-written — which is how this documentation came to tell
Codex users to put skills in `~/.codex/skills`, a directory Codex does not read.

| Agent | Skills | Hooks | MCP |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Claude Code | `~/.claude/skills` | yes | yes |
| OpenAI Codex | `~/.agents/skills` | yes | yes |
| Cursor | `~/.agents/skills` | not yet verified | yes |
| Gemini CLI | `~/.agents/skills` | not yet verified | yes |
| GitHub Copilot | `~/.copilot/skills` | not yet verified | yes |
| opencode | `~/.config/opencode/skills` | not yet verified | yes |
| Pi | `~/.agents/skills` | not yet verified | yes |
| Windsurf | `~/.codeium/windsurf/skills` | not yet verified | yes |
| Zed | `~/.agents/skills` | not yet verified | yes |
| Amp | `~/.config/agents/skills` | not yet verified | yes |

**Hooks** says yes only where the host's hook contract has been verified against
this CLI by running it. A host that documents one this build has not tested is
wired for skills and told so, rather than being promised support nobody ran.

Codex 0.153 added a trust gate: an untrusted hook is skipped with no error and no
output, so approve it when Codex prompts or the guard stays silent.

## Registry installs

```bash
gh skill install Vulnetix/pix-ai-coding-assistant
npx skills add Vulnetix/pix-ai-coding-assistant
```

Both work because the canonical skills live at `skills/` in the repository root,
which is the convention each of them looks for. They install **skills only** —
hooks and MCP wiring still need `vulnetix agent install`.

## Claude Code marketplace

```
/plugin marketplace add Vulnetix/pix-ai-coding-assistant
/plugin install vulnetix@vulnetix-plugins
```
